passwords.title: Passwords
passwords.description: The team's and each client's passwords, encrypted end to end: they open with your master password, and neither the server nor anyone looking at the database can read them.
passwords.search: Search by name, username or site…
passwords.autoLocked: The vault locked itself after {minutes} minutes unused.

setup.title: The team password
setup.description: There is no vault yet. Choose the password the three of you will use: whoever knows it sees everything.
setup.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. The same for everyone; do not reuse it anywhere else.
setup.mismatch: Does not match the one above.
setup.warning: Write it down somewhere safe and share it only among yourselves: it is stored nowhere and cannot be recovered. Lose it and the saved passwords are lost.
setup.created: Vault created: you can start saving passwords.

unlock.title: Open the vault
unlock.description: Type the team password. It stays in this browser and the vault locks itself after a while unused.
unlock.wrong: That is not the team password.
unlock.failed: The vault could not be opened.

sheet.description: Everything you type here is encrypted before it leaves the browser.
sheet.name: Name
sheet.totpHint: The string behind the QR code when you turn on two-step verification, in case it has to be recovered.
sheet.archiveConfirm: It disappears from the list. Who archived it and when stays in the audit log.

errors.notFound: That password no longer exists or you have no access.
errors.alreadyExists: The vault already exists: ask a partner for the password.

change.title: Change the team password
change.description: Change it when someone leaves the team or if you think anyone else knows it.
change.newPasswordHint: {count, plural, =0 {At least 12 characters.} one {At least 12 characters. # saved password will be re-encrypted.} other {At least 12 characters. # saved passwords will be re-encrypted.}}
change.changed: Password changed: tell the rest of the team.
